usageNotes: Use this to update the CIDR, comment, or name of an existing cluster-level firewall alias. Requires `Sys.Modify` on `/`. Pass the `digest` field (obtained from the GET alias endpoint) to guard against concurrent edits overwriting each other. To rename an alias, supply the new name in `rename` while the path `{name}` remains the current name.

examples.summary: Update alias CIDR and rename it from 'office-net' to 'hq-net'

tips: The `digest` param is the SHA1 of the current config file — fetch it via GET /cluster/firewall/aliases/{name} before updating to enable optimistic concurrency control.
Alias names must start with a letter and may only contain letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores (pattern: [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9\-\_]+); the new name in `rename` follows the same constraint.
This operation is cluster-wide; the updated alias is immediately available to all node and VM firewall rules that reference it.
